recommendation.rationale: Fleischner recommends, for a solitary, pure ground-glass/non-solid, incidental pulmonary nodule 6mm or greater in diameter, in a patient >=35 years old with no known malignancy history and not immunocompromised: a CT at 6-12 months to confirm persistence, and, only if the nodule is confirmed persistent, continued CT surveillance every 2 years until 5 years. The Local SOP's own wording states this boundary as '>6mm'; the governed executable boundary is '>=6mm', per explicit clinical HITL approval treating the Local SOP wording as an imprecise transcription of the underlying Fleischner 2017 source table (see clinical/sources/local-sop.json findings).
